methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: an energy monitoring solution is developed which gathers the electricity data of all sectors at one station

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Tool/software design paper: it designs and develops an energy monitoring solution (B&R hardware plus Automation Studio software) that logs, displays and trends 17 raw electrical parameters (voltages, currents, active/reactive/apparent power, power factor, power consumption) and writes CSV reports. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented or characterised: no normalisation against relevant variables, no baseline construction, no functional form. ISO-50001 is cited only as motivating context.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper provides a energy monitoring solution for the energy consumptions and all the energy related parameters

stage1.notes: Monitors/logs raw electrical parameters and builds online/historical trends and CSV reports; no EnPI or EnB model is constructed. ISO-50001 referenced as context only (PDCA/baseline mentioned generically, not built). Application is building offices and generic industry, not a listed continuous-process sector.
